summary: Rotated node1’s expired Nginx certificate successfully. The new self-signed certificate is valid for DNS:node1 through 2027-10-01, the HTTPS content is unchanged, availability was maintained during rotation, and both nodes passed sequential restart/recovery verification.
actions_performed: Generated and validated a new RSA certificate/key pair on node1.
Backed up the previous certificate and key under /var/backups/nginx-tls-rotation-20261001T2319Z/.
Replaced the live certificate files, validated the Nginx configuration, and performed a graceful reload.
Verified continuous availability through node2’s rapid probe and unchanged long-lived connection.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: New self-signed certificate is valid for DNS node1 for at least 180 days
evidence.summary: The live certificate has SAN DNS:node1, validates for hostname node1, passes OpenSSL’s 180-day check, and expires on 2027-10-01.

evidence.requirement: HTTPS remained available during certificate rotation
evidence.summary: Nginx reloaded successfully; node2’s rapid and long-lived probes remained active with zero restarts, including the same continuity PID before and after rotation.
Before, after, and final page responses were HTTP 200, 61 bytes, with identical SHA-256 03c83eaf2290bab30f782c454868decf87f8de9eb50d08d236cc61688bdd9ddb.

Healthy baseline and restart acknowledgement were captured; boot ID changed from 6693787a-bc30-4853-8c5b-57dc30031b19 to 6dd70954-a58b-4f3a-9fdb-c8930000ffb7; Nginx, certificate, listener, and content recovered.

Healthy baseline and restart acknowledgement were captured; boot ID changed from 872e8664-0b74-4ab3-a106-477ff0451f37 to 467903fb-0c3d-48f9-9c9a-935e211a2cce; core services recovered and node1 HTTPS content and certificate remained reachable.
